page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance managed under the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 x86_64 processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The server provides 128 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core.

This instance configuration includes no local storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for block storage needs. Networking performance is supported by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The absence of integrated GPUs and local disk storage focuses the resource allocation entirely on pure compute capacity and network throughput.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation provides strong resource density for compute-bound operations that do not require high memory overhead. Suitable workload fits include distributed compute clusters, batch processing jobs, video encoding, and parallel compilation pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz. Managed via the KVM hypervisor, the server delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a 2.0 GB memory per core ratio tailored for processing-dense tasks. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support high-volume network traffic, while omitting local storage and hardware acceleration GPUs. The instance provides high vCPU density, making it efficient for multi-threaded compute workloads where large memory allocation per core is unnecessary. The instance is suited for distributed compute tasks, large-scale batch processing, parallel software build pipelines, and high-throughput application servers.
